lines.text: Good evening, and welcome, welcome, welcome to Your Call! The only show in the void where the audience decides and nobody goes home.

lines: Because nobody has a home. Because you are all [red]dead[/red]. Give it up for being [red]dead[/red]!

lines.text: Tonight you are in the audience. One vote in a [amber]thousand[/amber]. Your vote counts exactly as much as everyone else's, which is barely at all. Let us meet our contestants!

beats.title: Applause
ask: Our first contestant, ladies and gentlemen! Watch the step. Ooh.
The sign says applause. The whole room is clapping. Do you clap?

options.label: Clap
reaction: You clapped. The sign said clap, and you clapped. Good audience. Good, good audience.

options.label: Sit on your hands
reaction: You sat on your hands while a thousand [red]dead[/red] people clapped at a man on his face. Nobody saw. Nobody will ever know. Very brave. Very invisible.

beats.title: The Trapdoors
ask: Round one! Two contestants, two trapdoors, one vote.
On the left, a charmer. Dances, waves, remembers your name. On the right, a sweet old soul who has forgotten why they came.
The audience keeps one. The other goes through the floor. You are one vote in a [amber]thousand[/amber]. Vote.

left: You and six hundred others kept the charmer. Down goes the old one. You were a rounding error.
right: You voted for the charmer. The room did not. Down goes the dancer, still waving. Your vote went through the floor with him.

left: You voted for the old one. So did nearly four hundred others. Lovely of you all. Down she goes anyway.
right: You voted for the old one, and the room agreed. Down goes the dancer, still waving. You did not swing it. You never do.

beats.title: The Wheel
ask: Round two! Our contestant has won [amber]ten thousand dollars[/amber]. She is playing for her son's operation.
One spin of the wheel: double it, or lose the lot. She has left it to you. All of you. Spin, or take the money?

doubled: Spun, and doubled! [amber]Twenty thousand[/amber]. Her son gets his operation and a pony. You gambled with a stranger's child and won. Enjoy that. She will not sleep for a week.
lost: Spun, and lost. Every penny. She is smiling, because the camera is on her. You did that. Well. You and four hundred others.
kept: You wanted the spin. The room did not. Saved from yourself by a crowd of [red]dead[/red] strangers.
The room took the money. Safe, sensible, [amber]ten thousand[/amber]. Somewhere a pony weeps.
doubled: You said take the money. The room spun anyway, and it doubled. She is rich, and you look like an accountant.
lost: You said take the money. The room spun. Gone. You can tell her you voted the other way. She will not care.

beats.title: The Returning Champion
ask: And now, our returning champion! [amber]Forty[/amber] wins in a row! You know it, you loathe it, it is the button!

ask.text: Forty one tonight. Write it down.
ask.speaker: button

ask: The audience can vote it off. Vote it off, or let it play?

off.text: RIGGED! This show is RIGGED! I want to see the votes!
off.speaker: button

off: It wants to see the votes. Show it the votes.

stays.text: Ha! Forty one! You love me. You all love me.
stays.speaker: button

stays: Nobody loves you. They just hate change more.

off.text: RIGGED! You! I saw you! You were the only one!
off.speaker: button

off: It is right, for once. You were nearly the only one.

stays.text: Ha! Forty one! You love me. You all love me.
stays.speaker: button

stays: You kept it. The room kept it. Nobody wanted this, and here we all are.

beats.title: Split or Steal
ask: Split or steal! [amber]A hundred thousand dollars[/amber] in the pot. Both split, they share it. One steals, the thief takes it all. Both steal, nobody gets a penny.
The producers have put you in the left one's earpiece. He will do whatever you say. Tell him.

shared: Both split! [amber]Fifty thousand[/amber] each. Hugs. Tears. You told a stranger to trust a stranger, and it worked. Do not get used to it.
robbed: He split. The other one stole. Every penny, and a wave to camera. You told him to trust. He did. He is going home with a keyring.

took_all: He stole. The other one split. All of it. The other one is crying on the floor. Television.
nothing: Both stole. Nobody gets anything. Two thieves and a pot of nothing. The most honest thing that has happened on this show.

beats.title: The Collapse
ask: And while we take a short break. Oh. Oh dear. Contestant down. Stage left.
Somebody should help. A thousand people saw it. He needs [amber]three hundred[/amber] of you on your feet.
Do you get up, or wait for somebody else to?

lives: You got up. So did enough others. He is sitting up and asking for water. A thousand [red]dead[/red] people saved a [red]dead[/red] man. Do not ask me what that means.
dies: You got up. Not enough of the others did. He [red]died[/red] waiting for the three hundred and first. You were there. You were just not enough.

lives: You waited. Enough of the others did not. He lives, and you get to feel fine about it. You will.
dies: You waited. So did everyone. He [red]died[/red] with a thousand people watching, each of them sure somebody else would go.

beats.title: The Mystery Box
ask: The final! Our finalist can take [amber]fifty thousand dollars[/amber], or the box. Nobody knows what is in the box. Well. I know.
The audience decides. The money, or the box?

money: The money. Sensible. [amber]Fifty thousand[/amber]. The box stays shut forever, and you will never know. It was a cucumber. Now you know.
box: You said the money. The room said the box. Open it. Open it! It is a cucumber. Of course it is a cucumber.
The box! Open it. Open it! It is a cucumber. Of course it is a cucumber. It is always a cucumber.
money: You wanted the box. The room took the money. You will never know. It was a cucumber. Now you know.

lines.text: And that is the show! Thank you, thank you, you have been a [amber]thousand[/amber] wonderful corpses.

lines: One last thing, off air. Every vote you cast tonight, the room would have gone exactly the same way without you. Every single one. Your vote changed [amber]nothing[/amber].

lines.text: And you voted anyway. Or you did not. I wrote down which. We will be right back. We will not.
